success.description: You speak calmly and softly. Each living creature that can hear you recovers 1 stress and will generally perceive you more favourably. If appropriate, this may influence the target.
As above, plus while this card is recharging, living creatures that can hear and understand you add {Dc}4 to their dice pools for any hostile action that includes you as a target.

boon.description: You may move your Party Tension meter 1 space to the left.

bane.description: Move your Party Tension meter 1 space to the right.
